dishes.name: Braunschweiger Mettwurst
dishes.desc: Smoked, spreadable pork sausage that Braunschweig butchers have made for centuries. Eaten sliced on bread, it is the city's best-known food.

dishes.name: Prilleken
dishes.desc: Small fried yeast-dough balls dusted with sugar, a long-standing Braunschweig treat sold at fairs and bakeries.

dishes.name: Harzer cheese
dishes.desc: Strong-smelling, fat-free sour-milk cheese from the Harz foothills, usually eaten with onions and vinegar on dark bread.

dishes.name: Braunschweig wedding soup
dishes.desc: Clear chicken broth with asparagus, small meatballs and egg custard. A festive soup of Braunschweig and the Altmark.
